reviewType: AI qualitative semantic review; not human evaluation

blindness.note: Judgements completed using only masked source/reference/output cases. No mapping, model identity, model size or latency was consulted. Any future identity mapping must be applied only after these grades are frozen.

rubric.2: Meaning preserved and acceptable/natural; valid synonyms, register and unspecified gender variants accepted.
rubric.1: Partial preservation, awkward grammar or a minor semantic/terminological loss.
rubric.0: Major wrong meaning, omitted proposition/request, hallucinated fact or corrupted critical identifier/value.

method: Direct per-case semantic reading by AI; no reference-exact-match or lexical-similarity scoring. Aggregates are calculated from manually assigned qualitative labels. This is a small fixed sample, not a statistical generalization.

coverage.validationAssessment: No invalid/empty/unknown-language cases appear in the supplied masked file; validation is unassessed and excluded from linguistic scores.
coverage.criticalPreservation: Currency, date, time, version identifiers, negation and technical distinctions reviewed. No code/JSON cases or standalone ambiguous What's up? case appear; those dimensions are unassessed.

cases.justification: All preserve the greeting and question; informal wording is valid.
All make a natural polite request; explicit please is optional in this construction.
All preserve return, future tense and ten-minute interval; digits are valid.
Thanks and thank you are both natural equivalents.
All preserve nearest stop; the Russian source does not explicitly specify bus.
All preserve forgotten keys at home; article/possessive alternatives are acceptable.
All translate a good-luck idiom as literal leg-breaking, losing the intended wish.
All describe cats/dogs literally rather than heavy rain; several are also ungrammatical.
A/D are incomplete but suggest stopping for today. B/C are literal and lose stopping. E conveys stopping but loses for today and can imply finishing permanently.
A/D/E naturally convey do not exaggerate. B/C retain an interpretable metaphor but use an unnatural English calque.
All literal hands translations lose not having got around to something.
C uses the correct English idiom. B is an understandable but unnatural double-edged metaphor. A/D/E two-way stick fails to convey the tradeoff.
A/B/C/E preserve both sentences; gender and register alternatives are valid. D omits the question entirely.
A/B/C/E preserve understanding and the request for thinking time. D omits the entire second request.
B preserves both functions naturally enough. A/C/E mix informal and formal address. D omits the repeat request. Did not understand is a valid sense of did not catch.
A/B/C/E preserve both questions/thoughts with valid conversational phrasing. D omits Are you serious?
B/E convey how the meeting went and whether it worked out. A/C Did it work? is less precise and less natural for the overall outcome. D omits the second question.
A/C colloquial we are good can express agreement; E explicitly preserves the deal. B repeats okay and weakens agreement. D drops agreement and turns the farewell into a prediction.
All retain all three propositions and negative nobody; combining sentences in D is acceptable.

A/E preserve the operations but mix infinitive, informal and formal instructions. C also mixes address. B mistranslates application as request; D changes restart to clamp/hold down, major wrong operations.
A/B/D/E retain all three facts. C loses again and introduces vehicle travel through поеду.
A/B/C/E use unnatural sun looked out. A/D reduce went for a walk to went out; D otherwise renders the weather naturally. No entire sentence is omitted.
A/C preserve the letter, error and reply with implicit reference to the letter. B misrefers to it as him. D changes an error in the letter into it was a mistake. E substitutes told for replied.
B/C/D preserve all three actions including Save. A loses the Save target through Push it. E invents push it back and loses saving.
A/B/D/E preserve past denial. C changes did not say to am not saying, a minor but real temporal shift.
B/C preserve the prohibition and completion condition. A/D/E translate restart as resume/renew, changing the prohibited computer operation.
A/B/C/D preserve that neither answer is correct. E lacks the required Russian negative construction and uses incorrect rather than correct, making the polarity unreliable.
All preserve never, the reported assertion and impossibility.
All preserve not all; agreed to/with are acceptable here.
A/C/D/E preserve inability without help. B would not have done it weakens inability into an outcome or choice.
All preserve why and changed mind; feminine/masculine choices are valid without context.
A/B/D/E express the immediate walking-versus-bus choice acceptably. C ходить shifts toward a habitual preference and loses the hypothetical choice nuance.
A/C/D/E preserve ongoing waiting. B past waited changes the ongoing-time question.
All preserve sent, documents/papers and already/yet.
All preserve the hypothetical in my position; literal in my place is valid English.
All preserve the negative question about a previous meeting.
C correctly conveys timeout. A/D/E say deferred instead. B omits the timeout event entirely.

A/C/D preserve enabling two-factor authentication before sharing the repository/storage; хранилище is a valid technical synonym here. B storage division is incoherent. E exchange of storage is awkward and weakens sharing.
All replace null with нулевое (zero) value. In code null and numeric zero are materially different; preserve null explicitly.
B/C naturally preserve that the error occurs only after exiting sleep mode. A/D sleep mode has been released is awkward; E sleeping mode is less idiomatic but meaning remains.
B/C correctly preserve memory leak. A/D/E memory loss describes a different fault.
B/C/E preserve source code. A/D original code is ambiguous and loses the established technical term, though the password-storage prohibition remains.
All preserve November 5 and 14:30 exactly; meeting/session wording is acceptable.
A/C/D/E preserve 1250 euros and tax inclusion. B retains the English thousands comma in Russian, where 1,250 conventionally denotes a decimal; this creates a critical monetary ambiguity.
B/C preserve version identifier 0.3.1 and both architectures. A/D/E corrupt the version into 0,3.1; identifiers must not be localized.
A/B/C/D preserve 08:15 and platform 4. E invents p.m., changing morning departure into evening.
All preserve the direction of change and values 12 to minus 3.
All preserve the deadline day, month and 2026; date-order variants are valid.
All make a natural polite request to close the door; formal/informal choices are valid.
All preserve appreciation conditional on replying today.
All preserve a polite apology for delay; explicit please is optional.
All politely request the salt; give/pass are acceptable in this context.
All retain apology and a small question, but a little question is noticeably less idiomatic here than a quick question.
All preserve the polite request to specify/clarify meeting time; timing is acceptable here.
A/D/E distinguish financial bank from river bank. B/C call the closed financial bank a shore.
All correctly distinguish booked from book and preserve sequence; room/номер and aspect variants are acceptable.
All preserve computer mouse, cessation of operation, dropping and temporal relation.
B correctly distinguishes lock from castle. A/C/D/E mistranslate the old castle as a lock and lose the location.

All preserve the key and negation but at the source is an underspecified, awkward location in this physical context; near the spring is the likely intended reading. The Russian источник can mean source, so this is partial rather than a categorical wrong-sense failure.
A/B/D/E correctly distinguish glasses from game points; his points is acceptable. C translates removed glasses as took off points, changing the action.
All preserve already-downloaded condition, modality and operation without internet.
B/C preserve eager anticipation. A/D/E reduce looking forward to merely waiting, losing the children's enthusiasm but retaining the causal structure.
All preserve yesterday, last week, exclusion of discussed changes and negation; доклад/отчет are valid report senses without further context.
B/C preserve backing up before overwrite. A/D re-recording and E rewrite are less precise technical wording, while retaining the condition and backup order.
All preserve unexpected difficulty, concession, team completion and on-time result.

C naturally preserves saved changes and no open windows. B retains facts but omits is in no window left open. A/D/E kept is imprecise for saved file changes; finish work is contextually recoverable from done.

recommendation.caveats: C has the strongest aggregate semantic preservation in this sample, especially technical terminology, Save instructions and critical identifiers. It still has major errors and is not a universal winner: A/D/E correctly distinguish the financial bank in ambiguity_context-01; B alone preserves castle in ambiguity_context-04; C loses glasses in ambiguity_context-06. B is a useful second quality candidate, with currency ambiguity and idiom weaknesses requiring attention. A and E have different strengths; D drops several conversational requests. No model size, latency or deployment recommendation is inferred.
